_leia_me: Congelado do retrato de producao no commit 7754038 (git show 7754038:supabase/schema-esperado.json), isto e, ANTES da F44_3 ser aplicada. Guarda so as linhas que trancas-f44-banco.test.ts compara: 4 funcoes do chat e 3 politicas (invitations_insert, invitations_update, runs_select). O caso do rollback confere contra elas que desfazer a migration devolve o banco ao estado anterior; o schema-esperado.json atual ja tem os corpos NOVOS, entao nao serve para isso. Nao regrave: o ponto e ficar parado.
funcoes: add_conversation_member(p_conversation_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)|void|definer|volatile|postgres|ideworks_app=X/postgres,postgres=X/postgres|search_path=ideworks, pg_temp|declare v_actor uuid := ideworks.chat_require_actor(); v_kind ideworks.conversation_kind; v_count integer; v_inserted boolean := false; begin select kind into v_kind from ideworks.conversations where id = p_conversation_id; if not found then raise exception 'conversa nao encontrada' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if v_kind = 'general' then raise exception 'o Geral nao tem lista de membros para editar' using errcode = '22023'; end if; if not ideworks.chat_actor_manages(p_conversation_id) then raise exception 'so o dono ou administrador adiciona membros' using errcode = '42501'; end if; if not ideworks.chat_person_is_active(p_user_id) then raise exception 'so pessoa ativa e adicionada' using errcode = '22023'; end if; if v_kind = 'direct' then select count(*)::int into v_count from ideworks.conversation_members where conversation_id = p_conversation_id; if v_count >= 2 and not exists ( select 1 from ideworks.conversation_members where conversation_id = p_conversation_id and user_id = p_user_id ) then raise exception 'conversa direta nao aceita terceira pessoa' using errcode = '22023'; end if; end if; insert into ideworks.conversation_members (conversation_id, user_id, role) values (p_conversation_id, p_user_id, 'member') on conflict do nothing returning true into v_inserted; v_inserted := coalesce(v_inserted, false); update ideworks.conversations set archived_at = null, updated_at = now() where id = p_conversation_id and archived_at is not null; if v_inserted and v_kind = 'group' then perform ideworks.chat_insert_system_message( p_conversation_id, p_user_id, 'joined'); end if; end

chat_actor_manages(p_conversation_id uuid)|boolean|definer|stable|postgres|postgres=X/postgres|search_path=ideworks, pg_temp|select ideworks.acting_is_superadmin() or exists ( select 1 from ideworks.conversation_members m where m.conversation_id = p_conversation_id and m.user_id = ideworks.acting_user_id() and m.role = 'owner' )

chat_images_of_message(p_message_id uuid)|TABLE(id uuid, storage_path text)|definer|stable|postgres|ideworks_app=X/postgres,postgres=X/postgres|search_path=ideworks, pg_temp|declare v_conv uuid; begin select m.conversation_id into v_conv from ideworks.messages m where m.id = p_message_id; if not found then return; end if; if ideworks.acting_user_id() is not null then if not ideworks.can_reach_conversation(v_conv) then raise exception 'voce nao alcanca esta conversa' using errcode = '42501'; end if; else perform ideworks.assert_collector(); end if; return query select i.id, i.storage_path from ideworks.chat_images i where i.message_id = p_message_id order by i.created_at, i.id; end

send_chat_message(p_conversation_id uuid, p_body text, p_client_key text, p_image_ids uuid[])|TABLE(message_id uuid, conversation_id uuid, author_id uuid, body text, kind message_kind, created_at timestamp with time zone, edited_at timestamp with time zone, deleted_at timestamp with time zone, client_key text, recipient_ids uuid[])|definer|volatile|postgres|ideworks_app=X/postgres,postgres=X/postgres|search_path=ideworks, pg_temp|#variable_conflict use_column declare v_actor uuid := ideworks.chat_require_actor(); v_body text := btrim(coalesce(p_body, '')); v_key text := btrim(coalesce(p_client_key, '')); v_images uuid[] := coalesce(p_image_ids, '{}'::uuid[]); v_existing ideworks.messages%rowtype; v_count integer; v_row ideworks.messages%rowtype; v_recipients uuid[]; v_linked integer; v_expected integer; begin if v_key = '' or char_length(v_key) > 128 then raise exception 'chave de envio obrigatoria' using errcode = '22023'; end if; if v_body = '' and cardinality(v_images) = 0 then raise exception 'mensagem vazia nao e enviada' using errcode = '22023'; end if; if char_length(v_body) > 4000 then raise exception 'mensagem passa do teto de 4000 caracteres' using errcode = '22023'; end if; if not ideworks.can_reach_conversation(p_conversation_id) then raise exception 'voce nao alcanca esta conversa' using errcode = '42501'; end if; select m.* into v_existing from ideworks.messages m where m.author_id = v_actor and m.client_key = v_key; if found then if v_existing.conversation_id is distinct from p_conversation_id then raise exception 'chave de envio ja usada em outra conversa' using errcode = '22023'; end if; v_recipients := ideworks.chat_recipient_ids(p_conversation_id); return query select v_existing.id, v_existing.conversation_id, v_existing.author_id, v_existing.body, v_existing.kind, v_existing.created_at, v_existing.edited_at, v_existing.deleted_at, v_existing.client_key, v_recipients; return; end if; select count(*)::int into v_count from ideworks.messages m where m.author_id = v_actor and m.kind = 'person' and m.created_at >= now() - interval '1 minute'; if v_count >= 30 then raise exception 'limite de 30 mensagens por minuto; espere um pouco e tente de novo' using errcode = '54000'; end if; if v_body = '' and cardinality(v_images) > 0 then select string_agg( format('![Imagem anexada](attachment:%s)', x.id::text), E'\n\n' order by x.ord ) into v_body from unnest(v_images) with ordinality as x(id, ord); end if; insert into ideworks.messages as msg ( conversation_id, author_id, body, kind, client_key ) values ( p_conversation_id, v_actor, v_body, 'person', v_key ) returning msg.* into v_row; if cardinality(v_images) > 0 then v_expected := cardinality(v_images); update ideworks.chat_images ci set message_id = v_row.id where ci.id = any (v_images) and ci.conversation_id = p_conversation_id and ci.uploaded_by = v_actor and ci.message_id is null; get diagnostics v_linked = row_count; if v_linked <> v_expected then raise exception 'uma ou mais imagens nao puderam ser ligadas a mensagem' using errcode = '22023'; end if; end if; update ideworks.conversations as c set updated_at = now() where c.id = p_conversation_id; v_recipients := ideworks.chat_recipient_ids(p_conversation_id); return query select v_row.id, v_row.conversation_id, v_row.author_id, v_row.body, v_row.kind, v_row.created_at, v_row.edited_at, v_row.deleted_at, v_row.client_key, v_recipients; end
